SRC-225:R001.text: Inspect closure evidence, source closure, post-verification changes, invalidation, knowledge/evidence dependencies, fingerprints, ownership/admission and current reconciliation. Distinguish classifications A-E only from evidence; preserve uncertainty about the FastPrompter incident and do not implement its application fixes.

SRC-225:R002.text: Associate closed verified Work and its source requirements with meaningful implementation dependencies and reproducible focused verification. Detect affected dependencies, recheck focused behavior, distinguish CURRENT_REGRESSION from byte-change suspicion and inability to verify, and preserve original historical evidence unchanged.

SRC-225:R003.text: Keep newly found defects under ordinary legal owned Work, reuse active successor repairs and create no duplicate tickets. Avoid rerunning every historical test after unrelated edits; bound record, path and byte work for large repositories; report exact unavailable-verification reasons; reuse existing vocabulary and RV journals rather than a parallel state machine.
